content: coffee A controlled explosion on a film set near London's O2 arena ignited a fire that destroyed a van and damaged a car and a lorry. Firefighters were dispatched to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown just before eight p.m. on Saturday. After about an hour, twenty‑five crews had the blaze under control and reported no injuries. The incident is believed to have stemmed from a pre‑planned filming activity at the venue, which also stages upcoming shows by Niall Horan and Texas. The London Fire Brigade updated on X that the fire in the Silvertown yard is now contained, noting that one vehicle was lost and most of another car and lorry suffered damage, with no injury reports. They added that the fire originated from the controlled explosion that spread beyond expectations, and crews worked swiftly to extinguish it and will stay on site for the rest of the evening. The yard is close to the Thames cable car link, and a Metropolitan Police spokesman said they are aware of explosion reports heard near the O2 in Greenwich.
